scope: h5py 3.16.0 manylinux wheel (bundled HDF5 2.0.0) with NumPy 2.5.4 on Python 3.14 in an isolated POSIX process; parallelWrite and parallel extraction additionally use h5py 3.16.0 built from source against parallel HDF5 2.0.0 with mpi4py 4.1.2 and Open MPI 4.1.7 on one workstation (no cluster qualification). HDF Group h5dump 2.2.0 (current stable HDF5 library release) is the independent consumer. Other h5py, HDF5, NumPy or MPI builds are refused, not assumed compatible.
acceptance: Run tools/qualify_hdf5.py with the isolated runtime and h5dump; require every baseline/variant/adoption/lifecycle/tamper case.
A new h5py wheel or bundled HDF5 needs its own bounded native acceptance before absorbedVersion or the pinned runtime identity changes.
